title: Read a relay message
responsibility: Parse a relay message and check its recognized message shape.

inputs.name: relayFrame.text
inputs.description: Raw JSON text for a frame received by this host relay. Text whose JavaScript length exceeds remoteLimits.frameBytes + 4096 is rejected before parsing.

outputs.name: relayFrame
outputs.description: The parsed frame is returned when its type is ready, device-open, device-close, packet, pairing-request, device-revoked, or ack and its type-specific check passes. Returns null for over-limit text, invalid JSON, unrecognized types, or failed checks.
